seedseasons.guide.name: Xulai Seed Seasons Guide
seedseasons.guide.subtitle: Seasonal Farming Handbook
seedseasons.guide.landing: Welcome!$(br2)This book teaches you everything about $(item)Xulai Seed Seasons$(): crop seasons, day-based growth, water consumption, rain growth, and seasonal day & night length.$(br2)Start with the $(bold)Getting Started$() chapter on the left.
seedseasons.tooltip.bone_meal: Crop fertilizing: %s per crop per day, applies at the next 6 AM settlement, at least one stage each (+%s%% growth)
seedseasons.tooltip.bone_meal_disabled: Crops do not accept bone meal with the current settings
seedseasons.message.out_of_season_fertil: Out of season, fertilizing %s is blocked by Serene Seasons (the bone meal is still used up)

commands.seedseasons.not_listed: %s is not in the seed seasons list

commands.seedseasons.growth_removed: Removed the maturation time of %s, the default applies again
commands.seedseasons.no_item: Hold the seed or crop item you want to use in your main hand
